facts.fact: BCEAO says it set up the PI-SPI instant-payment interoperability platform, allowing account-to-account transfers between different types of accounts across the UMOA, of which Niger is a member.
BCEAO says it set up the regional payment systems STAR-UMOA, SICA-UMOA and SAGETIL-UMOA for the Union.

NER.note: Mentions user protection only as an aim of the fintech framework; no rule or redress stated.

facts.fact: BCEAO says the UMOA payment infrastructure includes STAR-UMOA, SICA-UMOA and SAGETIL-UMOA and the PI-SPI instant-payment platform, regional systems of the Union that includes Niger.

NER.note: Nothing on government payments to people.

facts.fact: BCEAO says PI-SPI allows account-to-account transfers between different types of accounts in the UMOA, which had 81 e-money initiatives at the end of 2025.

NER.note: Only a general remark that digitalisation improves public resource collection; no system stated.
